zh: 此外，尽管一些较贫困的农民可能被党煽动去抢劫富农，但总体而言，农民拒绝党把村庄划分为三个对抗阶级的做法。相反，几乎所有农民在面对城市和国家的外部世界时，都怀有一种村庄团结感。因此，大多数农民把富农视为社区领袖，而非剥削者。
en: Furthermore, even though some of the poorer peasants could be incited by the Party to pillage the kulaks, by and large the peasantry rejected the Party’s division of the village into three antagonistic classes. Instead, almost all peasants shared a sense of village solidarity vis-à-vis the outside world of the city and the state. Thus, most of the peasants viewed the kulaks as community leaders, not exploiters.

zh: 鉴于这种村庄团结，农民不想要、也不会接受的是由共产党组织的集体农庄。他们与党打交道的所有经验——战时共产主义的公然暴力、新经济政策操纵性的价格——都是负面的。而党在整个二十年代不停发出的反富农警告，在农民耳朵里听起来就像是对整个村庄的威胁。农民把1927年后逐步升级的集体化运动视为制度化的余粮征集制的前奏。
en: Given this village solidarity, what the peasants did not want and would not accept was a collective farm organized by the Communist Party. All of their experiences with the Party—the outright violence of War Communism, the manipulative pricing of the NEP—had been negative. And the Party’s ceaseless warnings against the kulaks throughout the twenties sounded to peasant ears like a threat to the whole village. The peasants saw the campaign for collectivization that built up after 1927 as a prelude to institutionalized

zh: 鉴于这种根深蒂固的心态，共产党人对自愿集体化的期待完全是乌托邦式的。恩格斯和考茨基在1890年代预想集体农业时，都坚持它必须是自愿的。1921年以后，列宁、托洛茨基、布哈林，甚至斯大林都曾发誓同样的话。然而，没有一个布尔什维克领袖公开面对过这个问题：如果农民拒绝集体化，党因此必须在强制和投降之间选择，他们该怎么办。即便斯大林事实上选择了强制，他也没有公开承认这一点。相反，强制被伪装成无产阶级和贫农对富农发动的阶级斗争，而富农正力图恢复“资本主义”。没有这种意识形态伪装，再加上大量的无知，党几乎不可能实施如此巨大规模的强制。此外，斯大林和他的队伍真心相信他们的运动是一场阶级斗争，因为党从掌权以来就没有用过别的说法。
en: In view of this ingrained mentality, the Communists’ expectation of voluntary collectivization was completely utopian. Engels and Kautsky in the 1890s, in anticipating collective agriculture, had insisted that it must be voluntary. After 1921 Lenin, Trotsky, Bukharin, and even Stalin had all sworn the same thing. Yet none of the Bolshevik leaders ever faced openly the question of what they would do if the peasants refused collectivization and the Party therefore had to choose between coercion and capitulation. Even when Stalin in fact chose coercion, he did not admit this publicly. Instead, coercion was camouflaged as a class war waged by the proletariat and the poorer peasants against the kulak, who was striving to restore “capitalism.” Without this ideological camouflage, plus a great dose of ignorance, the Party could hardly have carried out coercion on such a colossal scale. Besides, Stalin and his troops really believed their campaign was a class war, for the Party had talked in no other terms from the time it came to power.

zh: 这些考虑现在使我们能够处理本章开头提出的解释问题。首先是俄国历史中专制连续性和周期性自上而下革命的问题。这一现象当然不可否认；但真正的问题在于我们如何解释它，以及如何把一场革命与另一场革命联系起来。在这一点上，类比常常被与原因混为一谈，仿佛某种形而上学本质从伊凡经彼得一直运作到斯大林。
斯大林本人对这种思维的偏好也不能证明多少。他把自己与彼得和伊凡相比，是为了说明和辩护他已经出于其他原因决定要做的事；这些比较很难说是他着手行事时的灵感来源。在那个时候，他的意识形态参照是马克思主义和社会主义，尤其是作为领袖的列宁。
en: These considerations now make it possible to address the questions of interpretation posed at the beginning of this chapter. First there is the matter of autocratic continuity and periodic revolution from above in Russian history. The phenomenon, of course, is undeniable; but the real problem is how we explain it, and how we relate one episode of revolution to another. And on this score analogy is too often confused with cause, as if some metaphysical essence were operating from Ivan to Peter to Stalin.

Nor does Stalin’s own penchant for this type of thinking prove much. His self-comparisons with Peter and Ivan served to illustrate and justify what he had already decided to do for other reasons; they were hardly his inspiration when he set out to do it. At that point his ideological references were Marxism and socialism and, especially, Lenin the Leader.

zh: 因此，从经验上确立斯大林政策在布尔什维克传统中的来源非常容易；但要找到从伊凡或彼得通向这些政策的能够实际传递影响的历史途径，却极其困难，甚至不可能。支持传统俄国因素进入斯大林主义的说法，最多只能说大致相似的落后处境产生了大致相似的反应。但这远不等于说较早的反应导致了较晚的反应，或者说较晚的反应以某种神秘方式转世重现了较早的反应。1930年代俄国工业落后的性质，与十八世纪或十六世纪军事落后的性质之不同，正如意识形态统治的党治政治与君权神授的绝对主义的政治之不同。
en: Thus it is very easy to establish empirically the sources of Stalin’s policies in the Bolshevik tradition; but it is extremely difficult, if not impossible, to find empirical transmission belts leading to those policies from Ivan or Peter. The most that one can say in support of a traditional Russian input into Stalinism is that roughly analogous situations of backwardness produced roughly analogous responses. But this is a far cry from saying that the earlier responses caused the later one, or that the later response in some mysterious manner reincarnated the earlier ones. The nature of Russia’s industrial backwardness in the 1930s is as different from that of her military backwardness in the eighteenth or the sixteenth century as are the politics of ideocratic partocracy from those of divine-right absolutism.

zh: 此外，专制的强化远非俄国历史的唯一主题。特别是，从彼得时代到1917年，俄国一直朝着相反的方向稳步前进，走向一个更多元、更“欧洲”的秩序。俄国普遍服役制度的“解缚”（
）过程，从1762年贵族免除强制性国家服役，到1861年农民从农奴制中解放，从1864年通过地方自治局（
）实现地方自治和基本独立的司法，到1905年立法的杜马——简言之，走向市民社会的创立。
en: Moreover, the intensification of autocracy has hardly been the only theme in Russian history. In particular, from Peter’s time to 1917 Russia was moving steadily in the opposite direction, towards a more pluralistic and “European” order. The process of the “unbinding” (

) of the Russian universal service order proceeded from the gentry’s emancipation from compulsory state service in 1762 to the peasant’s emancipation from serfdom in 1861, and from local self-government through the
and a largely independent judiciary in 1864 to the legislative Duma of 1905—in short, to the creation of a civil society.

zh: 此外，如果我们从松散的类比转向更仔细的实际比较，就应当清楚：斯大林那种泰坦规模的自上而下革命，在俄国没有先例，在其他任何地方也没有。伊凡雷帝和彼得大帝都依托一个普遍服役国家来运作。
一个没有天然边界、农业基础薄弱、城市人口极少的国家，为了作为一个独立实体生存下去，后来又为了扩张，不得不全面动员其物质和人力资源。这意味着农民被束缚于贵族，以便后者能在专制沙皇的军队中服役；而贵族拥有土地和农奴，则以同样的服役为条件。俄国的普遍服役制度是欧洲最严酷的，尽管在更西边并非没有部分类似者，尤其是普鲁士。
en: Furthermore, if we move from loose analogies to a closer look at actual comparisons, it should be clear that revolution from above on Stalin’s titanic scale has no precedent in Russia, or anywhere else for that matter. Both Ivan the Terrible and Peter the Great worked with a universal service state.

A country with no natural frontiers, with a poor agricultural base, and with only a minuscule urban population was constrained to general mobilization of both its material and human resources in order to survive as an independent entity, and later in order to expand. This meant that the peasants were enserfed to the gentry in order to permit the latter to serve in the armies of the autocratic tsar, while the gentry’s possession of its lands and serfs was conditional on that same service. Russia’s was the harshest system of universal service anywhere in Europe, though it was not without partial parallels farther West, particularly in Prussia.

zh: 彼得大帝加强了从贵族到农奴所有社会阶级的国家服役要求，以便首次给俄国一支西式常备军。但他没有实质性地改变这一制度的基本结构；相反，他给已经存在的莫斯科服役国家披上了欧洲旧制度的形式。他之所以能做到这一点，是因为当时俄国专制的军事化制度与西方绝对主义的军事化制度之间的差别并不那么大。但他绝没有用自己的新秩序取代旧的俄国秩序。他统治的革命性方面在于文化上的西方化，而不在于社会和政治重组。
en: Peter the Great tightened the requirements of state service for all social classes, from the gentry to the serfs, in order to give Russia for the first time a standing army on the Western model. But he did not substantially alter the basic structure of the system; rather, he gave the form of a European ancien régime to the already existing Muscovite service state. He could do this because the difference between the militarized systems of Russian autocracy and of Western absolutism was not all that great at the time. But he in no way replaced the old Russian order with a new one of his own devising. The revolutionary aspect of his rule lay in cultural Westernization rather than in social and political reorganization.

zh: 诚然，伊凡雷帝的政策在社会上比彼得的更具破坏性。旧的世袭波雅尔贵族作为一个凝聚群体被有效地打碎，由服役贵族取代；伊凡的“政治警察”——特辖军（
）——获得了一个独立的领地，成为国中之国，专制的任性在那里是最高法律；整个莫斯科制度承受了如此巨大的压力，以致伊凡死后不久，它就在1605—1613年的大动乱（
）中崩溃了。虽然我们可以推测伊凡的政策是由于对波兰和瑞典进行的利沃尼亚战争失利所造成的压力，但我们并不真正知道他的动机；但这些政策不太可能像彼得的政策那样，明显构成对欧洲挑战的“现代化”回应。而且，伊凡政策的最终结果并不是革命性的，因为罗曼诺夫家族在动乱后恢复的莫斯科秩序，与伊凡之前存在的秩序在根本上相同。
en: Ivan the Terrible’s policies, to be sure, were more socially destructive than Peter’s. The old hereditary boyar aristocracy was effectively broken as a cohesive group and replaced by the service gentry; Ivan’s “political police,” the

, acquired a separate territorial realm-within-a-realm where autocratic caprice was the supreme law; and the whole Muscovite system was put under such strain that soon after Ivan’s death it collapsed in the great

of 1605-1613. Although we can surmise that Ivan’s policies were due to the pressure of the unsuccessful Livonian war with Poland and Sweden, we do not really know his motives; but it is not very likely that they add up to a “modernizing” response to the European challenge, as was clearly the case with Peter’s. The ultimate result of Ivan’s policies, moreover, was not revolutionary, for the Muscovite order restored by the Romanovs after the
was fundamentally the same as that which had existed before Ivan.

zh: 相比之下，斯大林的自上而下革命无法被置于任何与先前社会秩序（无论是新经济政策下还是旧制度下）的连续体中。但同样重要的是斯大林主义激进的意识形态外壳：在现实中，正是意识形态解释了斯大林革命的全面规模和巨大代价。另一方面，彼得和伊凡在为专制辩护时，只使用了欧洲传统中最常规的论据：要么是基督徒服从神授权力的义务，要么是自然法的命令。因此，尽管斯大林像彼得（但不像伊凡）一样，是在回应经济落后和军事滞后的压力，但他要使历史以社会主义新世界达到顶点的总体抱负，与其前任有限的、纯粹着眼于本国的计划完全不可通约。
en: Stalin’s revolution from above, in contrast, cannot be situated in any continuum with the social order that preceded it, whether under the NEP or the Old Regime. But just as important is the radical ideological envelope of Stalinism: in reality it is ideology that explains both the total scope and the inordinate cost of Stalin’s revolution. Peter and Ivan, on the other hand, in their justifications of autocracy, used only the most conventional arguments of the European tradition: either the Christian duty of submission to divinely ordained power or the imperatives of natural law. Thus, even though Stalin, like Peter (though not like Ivan), was responding to the pressures of economic backwardness and military lag, his overall ambition to bring history to its culmination with the new world of socialism is quite incommensurate with his predecessor’s limited, purely national projects.

zh: 同样，在解释他的制度时，斯大林的人格只能被赋予次要角色。1929年之前，关于他的性格能说的最坏的话，就是列宁说过的那句：斯大林“太粗鲁”，不适合承担国家责任——尽管列宁认为这种粗鲁在布尔什维克中间完全可以接受。诚然，斯大林生涯的总体记录显示，他残忍到施虐的程度，多疑到偏执的程度。不过，这在他的大攻势开始时并不明显。因此最好假定，他的性格并非一成不变，而是在攻势前所未有的风险压力下演变而成的。
en: Similarly, a secondary role must be assigned to Stalin’s personality in explaining his system. Before 1929 the worst that could be said about his character was what Lenin had said’that Stalin was “too rude” for state responsibilities—though Lenin deemed such rudeness quite acceptable among Bolsheviks. To be sure, the overall record of Stalin’s career shows him to be cruel to the point of sadism, and suspicious to the point of paranoia. Still, this was not apparent at the start of his Great Offensive. It is thus best to assume that his character was not a constant, but that it evolved under the pressure of the unprecedented risks of the Offensive.

zh: 1932年，在那场攻势进行到一半时，斯大林的妻子在一场激烈的争吵后自杀；争吵显然涉及他对农民的政策。尽管他很难说是个敏感的人，这件事必定对他产生某种不良影响。集体化的大屠杀无疑使他更加冷酷。后来，他告诉温斯顿·丘吉尔，那场磨难与战争一样可怕。
我们还可以假定，对于在恐怖饥荒时期已经深陷罪行的斯大林来说，任何进一步的罪行只会来得更容易。就像毒品一样，越来越大的罪行剂量只能产生越来越小的效果，谋杀可能退化为纯粹的习惯。因此，虽然斯大林的犯罪性并不单纯源于他的性格，但他的犯罪性格可能越来越源于他的罪行。
en: In 1932, in the midst of that Offensive, Stalin’s wife committed suicide after a violent argument that apparently concerned his policies toward the peasants. Even though he was hardly a sensitive man, this must have produced some effect on him, and for the worse. And the carnage of the collectivization no doubt hardened him even more. Later, he told Winston Churchill that the ordeal had been as frightful as the war.

We may also assume that for one so deep in crime as was Stalin by the time of the terror famine, any further crime could only come more easily. As with a drug, ever larger doses of crime could only produce a lesser effect, and murder could degenerate into mere habit. Thus, although Stalin’s criminality did not simply derive from his character, his criminal character may have increasingly derived from his crimes.

zh: 但比历史或心理学更重要的是斯大林运作其中的制度环境，一个既滋生残忍又滋生偏执的环境。正如党的宣传鼓动不断宣告的，党正处于一场你死我活的阶级斗争中。它被内外的敌人包围：国际资本、小资产阶级富农、资产阶级破坏分子，以及党内的偏离分子。斯大林无疑亲自加剧了这种普遍斗争和猜疑的情绪，但他绝不是它的创造者；它毋宁源于党的全部遗产。这是一个与他的“粗鲁”性格一拍即合的党。
en: But more important than history or psychology is the institutional setting in which Stalin operated, a setting that bred both cruelty and paranoia. The Party, as its agitprop ceaselessly proclaimed, was in a class war to the death. It was surrounded by enemies without and within: international capital, petty bourgeois kulaks, bourgeois wreckers, and deviationists within the Party. Stalin no doubt personally aggravated this mood of universal struggle and suspicion, but he by no means created it; it derived, rather, from the Party’s whole heritage. This was a Party with which his “rude” character meshed only too readily.

zh: 因此，要发现大转折背后的推动力，我们必须回到自共产主义在1918年战斗和军事狂热中首次发现其天职以来一直驱动它的东西。推动布尔什维克第二次攻势的，与推动第一次攻势的是同一样东西：党自身作为把人类带入社会主义的军事—政治工具的天职。党没有其他存在的理由。到1929年，在徒然等待社会主义出现十二年后，强行推动历史进程、以意志行为建设未来的时刻到了。替代方案不是布哈林的“长入社会主义”；替代方案是党的意识形态动能在无休止地等待庄稼汉中消散。而随着意识形态的消散，党垄断权力的意志也会随之削弱。
en: To discover the impetus behind the Great Break, therefore, we must return to what had been the driving force of Communism since it first discovered its vocation in the militant and military frenzy of 1918. What fueled Bolshevism’s Second Offensive was what had fueled the first: the vocation of the Party itself as the military-political vehicle for bringing humanity into socialism. The Party had no other reason for existing. By 1929, after twelve years of vainly waiting for socialism to appear, the time had come to force the hand of history and to build the future by an act of will. The alternative was not Bukharin’s “growing into socialism”; the alternative was the withering away of the Party’s ideological momentum in an interminable effort to wait out the muzhik. And with the dissipation of ideology, the Party’s will to monopolize power would have eroded as well.

zh: 于是战时共产主义的第二幕启动了，但它以比第一幕大得多的规模和强度展开。而且，这次行动的基调相当不同：1918年看到的是狂热的歇斯底里，未经预谋、未经排练；1930年看到的则是冷酷的歇斯底里，经过高度准备和引导。这是因为1930年要完成的任务比1918年更复杂，而党军现在人数更多、更有纪律、更强大。让我们回顾导致这次第二次攻势的因果序列。
en: So the second episode of War Communism was launched, but it unfolded with a much greater sweep and intensity than the first. And the tone of the operation was quite different: Whereas 1918 had seen a hot hysteria, unpremeditated and unrehearsed, 1930 saw a colder hysteria, prepared and channeled to a high degree. This was because the tasks to be accomplished in 1930 were more complicated than those in 1918, and the Party-army was now more numerous, disciplined, and stronger. Let us recall the sequence of causation leading to this Second Offensive.

zh: 革命和战时共产主义使俄国比1917年前更加落后。因此，当1921年后市场重生时，农民成为国家经济命运的仲裁者。到1926年，政权别无选择，只能增加工业投资，哪怕只是为了更新陈旧衰败的设备；但党同时希望建设社会主义，以给自己一个工人和城市的“基础”。然而，党对市场和富农“资本主义”的意识形态不信任，使它所定的价格太低，无法维持农民的生产积极性。于是1927年，就在工业扩张起飞之际，城市的食品变得短缺。提高国家价格、其余依靠市场的解决办法被拒绝，因为这会使党及其工业纲领成为不可控制的、“无政府状态的”和“资本主义的”力量的人质。因此，决定通过立即全面集体化，用强制手段夺取农民的粮食。一旦作出这一选择，也就必须最大限度地加速工业扩张。而这两个决定加在一起，意味着压制市场以及所有靠市场为生的社会阶级，从富农到耐普曼。
en: The Revolution and War Communism made Russia much more backward than she had been before 1917. Thus, when the market was reborn after 1921, the peasants became the arbiters of the country’s economic destiny. By 1926 the regime had no choice but to increase investment in industry, if only to renovate an obsolete and decaying plant; but the Party at the same time wished to build socialism to give itself a worker and urban “base.” Yet the Party’s ideological distrust of both the market and kulak “capitalism” led it to set prices too low to keep the peasants producing. Thus in 1927 foodstuffs became scarce in the cities just as industrial expansion was taking off. The solution of raising state prices and relying on the market for the rest was rejected, since this would have made the Party and its industrial program hostage to uncontrollable, “anarchic,” and “capitalist” forces. Therefore, it was decided to take the peasants’ grain by coercion through immediate and full collectivization. Once this choice had been made, it also became necessary to accelerate industrial expansion to the maximum. And these two decisions together meant suppressing the market as well as all social classes that lived off it, from the kulaks to the nepmen.

zh: 但这等于通过把整个社会完全从属于党国，一举“解决”所有问题。于是一步不可阻挡地导向下一步，一直通向一个新极权秩序的创造。俄国历史没有导致这一结果的总体逻辑；但布尔什维克主义确实有这样的逻辑——只要环境允许党把其马克思主义幻想充分付诸行动，它就可以实现。1918—1921年，经济崩溃的环境截断了布尔什维克自我实现的进程。1929—1933年，一个更强大的党和一个状况尚可（至少开始时如此）的经济，使党得以把马克思主义逻辑推进到底。
en: But this amounted to a total “solution” to all problems at once through the total subordination of the whole of society to the Party-state. Thus one step inexorably led to another, all the way to the creation of a new, totalitarian order. There is no overall logic of Russian history leading to this result; but there

such a logic of Bolshevism—realizable should circumstances permit the Party to act out fully its Marxist fantasy. In 1918-1921 the circumstances of economic breakdown cut the process of Bolshevik self-realization short. In 1929-1933 the circumstances of a stronger Party and an economy in reasonable health (at least at the start) permitted the Party to take the Marxist logic to its resolution.

zh: 然而，这并不意味着党有意识地渴望、甚至预见到它到达那个顶点时所发现的东西。相反，如同1918年，它一路即兴发挥，才发现了自己真正的纲领是什么。苏维埃社会主义不是按照任何真正的计划建成的，而仿佛是被黑格尔的“理性的狡计”所驱动——也就是说，攻势的结果由制度自身的逻辑决定，这种逻辑以领导者并不完全明了的方式引导着党。于是斯大林及其手下在试错过程中、从一个危机走向另一个危机，最终建立了到1935年形成的低产集体农庄制度和军事工业体系。当然，当他们到达那里时，别无选择，只能宣布这些就是他们一直追求的“社会主义”结果。
en: This does not mean, however, that the Party consciously desired or even anticipated what it found when it reached that culmination, Instead, as in 1918, it improvised its way into discovering what its true program was. Soviet socialism was built not out of any genuine plan but as if driven by Hegel’s “cunning of reason”—that is, the outcome of the Offensive was determined by the logic of the system itself, a logic leading the Party in ways not fully apparent to its leaders. Thus Stalin and his men moved by a process of trial and error, and from one crisis to another, to arrive at the unproductive kolkhoz system and the military-industrial complex they had created by 1935. And when they got there, of course, they had no choice but to proclaim that these were the “socialist” results they had aimed at all along.

zh: 事实上，有一段时间，他们并不确定自己究竟能否达到这种“社会主义”。斯大林一开始就知道，他的攻势是一场高风险赌博，赌上了制度的生存。诚然，列宁在十月和再次在布列斯特—立托夫斯克赌上了一切，但当时可失去的东西远少于1929年已经存在一个苏维埃国家的时候。而且，到1931—1932年，看起来斯大林将要输掉这场赌博，因为农业和工业两方面的早期失误已把国家抛入如此混乱，以致再次看来整个制度可能崩溃。直到1933年，秋粮收获、马格尼托哥尔斯克等工业项目终于开始生产之后，斯大林才赢了他的赌博。直到1934年1月第十七次党代表大会，党才自1930年1月以来第一次放心地松了一口气，并宣布其攻势“胜利”。
en: In fact, for a time they were not sure they would reach this “socialism” at all. Stalin knew at the start that his Offensive was a high-risk gamble that put the survival of the system at stake. To be sure, Lenin had gambled everything in October and again at Brest-Litovsk, but at that time there was much less to lose than in 1929 when a Soviet state existed. And, indeed, by 1931-1932 it looked as though Stalin would lose his gamble, for the early blunders in both agriculture and industry had thrown the country into such chaos that it seemed, once again, as if the whole system might collapse. It was only in 1933, after the fall harvest had been brought in and such industrial projects as Magnitogorsk had at last begun producing, that Stalin won his gamble. It was only in January 1934, at the Seventeenth Party Congress, that the Party could draw its first confident breath since January 1930 and proclaim the “victory” of its Offensive.

zh: 于是又一次生存危机被克服了。它之所以被克服，是因为在危险最高的时候，党出于一种本能反射，在领袖身后紧密团结起来。普列奥布拉任斯基和他在左派的大多数同僚聚集到斯大林周围，因为他正在实施——尽管方式粗糙——他们的纲领，也因为他们无法忍受被排除在建设社会主义之外。他们中的尤里·皮亚塔科夫不仅成为谢尔戈·奥尔忠尼启则的副手，而且确实是工业化运动背后的真正大脑。布哈林和右派大多数人也同样如此，尽管他们宣称忠于农民和市场，因为他们也无法忍受被排除在大攻势之外，无论其执行多么拙劣，其领袖多么粗俗。值得注意的是，没有一名著名的布尔什维克退党或公开抗议其罪行。只有此时已被驱逐出国的托洛茨基公开反对斯大林的“错误”——但只是把它们说成是对他托洛茨基正确政策的歪曲。
en: Thus another crisis of survival was surmounted. And it was surmounted because, at the height of the danger, the Party in a visceral reflex had closed ranks behind the Leader. Preobrazhenskii and most of his colleagues on the Left rallied to Stalin because he was implementing, however crudely, their platform, and because they could not bear to be left out of the building of socialism. One of them, Iurii Piatakov, not only became Sergo Ordzhonikidze’s deputy but was indeed the real brains behind the industrialization drive. Bukharin and most of the Right, despite their declared commitment to the peasant and the market, did the same because they too could not bear being left out of the Great Offensive, no matter how botched its execution and how uncouth its leader. It is noteworthy that not one prominent Bolshevik resigned from the Party or publicly protested its crimes. Only Trotsky, who by now had been expelled from the country, openly campaigned against Stalin’s “mistakes”—but as distortions of his, Trotsky’s, correct policies.

zh: 然而，真正带领党度过危机的不是这些旧人，而是尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫这类人及其更单纯的信仰。1928年沙赫特事件期间，赫鲁晓夫在家乡顿巴斯地区积极参与打击“破坏分子”；此后不久，他前往基辅，成为乌克兰党组织部的负责人。1929年，莫斯科开办了一所工业学院（实际上是一所成人教育机构），培养工人阶级出身的党的干部，以便在如今革命化的经济中承担责任，赫鲁晓夫成为它的首批学生之一。在那里，他参与把一群同学作为“右倾偏离分子”开除。1931年，在前乌克兰党总书记卡冈诺维奇的推荐下，他成为莫斯科一个区的党委书记，并帮助清洗其右派前任留京（Riutin）的支持者（关于留京，稍后还会详述）。
en: Yet what really brought the Party through the crisis were not these holdovers but the likes of Nikita Khrushchev and their simpler faith. In 1928, during the Shakhty affair, Khrushchev was active against “wreckers” in his home region of the Donbas; shortly thereafter he moved to Kiev to become head of the Organization Department of the Ukrainian Party. In 1929 an Industrial Academy (in effect, a school for adult education) opened in Moscow to train Party cadres of working-class background to assume responsibilities in the now revolutionary economy, and Khrushchev became one of its first students. There he participated in expelling a group of fellow students as “Right deviationists.” In 1931, on the recommendation of the former General Secretary of the Ukrainian Party, Kaganovich, he became a Party district secretary in Moscow and helped clean out the supporters of his Rightist predecessor, Riutin (of whom more shortly).

zh: 1934年，39岁的赫鲁晓夫在“胜利者代表大会”上当选中央委员，作为奖赏。此后不久，他接替卡冈诺维奇（后者已被提拔到更高职位）出任莫斯科党组织首脑，从而接管莫斯科地铁建设的监督工作。斯大林把赫鲁晓夫这样向上流动的工农出身党的工作者称为“社会的中坚”。像领袖本人一样，他们可以十分真诚地把自己视为掌权的无产阶级；他们也可以同样真诚地感到，自己天生有权为建设社会主义和改善全人类而行使阶级专政。
en: In 1934, at the age of 39, Khrushchev was rewarded by election to the Central Committee at the Congress of Victors. Soon thereafter he succeeded Kaganovich (who had been promoted to higher things) as Moscow Party chief and thus took over supervision of the construction of the Moscow Metro. It is upwardly mobile worker-peasants turned Party-workers like Khrushchev that Stalin called the “salt of the earth.” Like the Leader himself, they could quite sincerely see themselves as the proletariat in power; and they could feel just as sincerely that they had an inherent right to exercise their class dictatorship for the building of socialism and the betterment of all mankind.

zh: 但他们努力的结果真的是“社会主义”吗？它显然不是“资本主义”，但仅此就足以使它有资格成为真正的“社会主义”吗？当时俄国以外的社会主义舆论在这个问题上存在分歧，而这个问题从此困扰着一切关于社会主义的讨论。随着斯大林的成就，世界社会主义的话语进入了一个全新的阶段。
en: But was the result of their efforts really “socialism?” It was clearly not “capitalism,” but is that enough to qualify it as true “socialism?” Socialist opinion outside Russian was divided over this question at the time, and it has bedeviled all discussion of socialism ever since. With Stalin’s achievement the discourse of world socialism entered a wholly new phase.

zh: 从1830年代到第一个五年计划，社会主义一直是一种属于未来的状态；随着斯大林的胜利，第一次可以宣称社会主义实际上存在于当下。它已从一种预期中的乌托邦变为一种可触知的现实，从一种运动变为一种社会。或者至少苏维埃政权声称这已经发生。因此，从那时起，任何社会主义者都必须不仅根据苏联“实验”，而且根据苏联“成就”来界定自己的立场。但决定苏维埃社会主义本体论地位的标准是什么？
en: From the 1830s to the First Five-Year Plan, socialism was a state that lay in the future; with Stalin’s victory for the first time it could be alleged that socialism actually existed in the present. It had passed from the status of a prospective utopia to that of a palpable reality, and from the status of a movement to a society. Or at least the Soviet regime claimed that this had occurred. From that time onward, therefore, any socialist had to define his position in terms not just of the Soviet “experiment” but of the Soviet “achievement.” But what are the criteria for deciding Soviet socialism’s ontological status?

zh: 苏联毫无疑问达到了非资本主义。它压制了私有财产、利润和市场，这显然是完整社会主义的工具性纲领。但据称会由这一纲领产生的大部分积极道德益处并没有出现；相反，可以看到大量未曾预料的负面后果。物质丰裕没有增长，贫困反而加深。人的自由没有进步，反而倒退为奴役。平等没有胜利，反而出现了按照党的目的而形成的人口新分层。人剥削人的现象没有终结；事实上，在此之上还加上了党国对所有人的剥削。
en: The Soviet Union had indubitably arrived at noncapitalism. It had suppressed private property, profit, and the market, and this is clearly the instrumental program of integral socialism. But most of the positive moral benefits that were supposed to result from this program had not appeared; on the contrary, a large number of unanticipated negative consequences could be observed. There was no growth of material abundance, but rather an increase of penury. There was no advance of human freedom, but instead a regression into servitude. There was no triumph of equality, but rather a new stratification of the population as a function of the Party’s purposes. There was no end of the exploitation of man by man; indeed, to this was added the exploitation of everybody by the Party-state.

zh: 简言之，党建成了社会主义，结果它却不是社会主义。或者更准确地说，党实现了社会主义的工具性纲领，但社会主义的道德纲领仍然留在未来。事实上，就社会主义道德而言，新的当下可以说比旧的资本主义过去更糟。
en: In short, the Party had built socialism, and it turned out not to be socialism. Or, to be more precise, the Party had realized the instrumental program of socialism, but socialism’s moral program still remained in the future. Indeed, the new present was arguably worse, in terms of socialist morality, than the old capitalist past.

zh: 应对这一出乎意料的矛盾结果有几种方式。一种是根本否认存在任何矛盾，并声称社会主义的道德后果确实从实践纲领中产生了。这是苏维埃政权采取的道路，而且很难看出，如果不承认自己失败了、制度是一场骗局，它还能怎么做。
en: There are several ways of coping with this unexpectedly contradictory outcome. One is to deny that any contradiction existed at all, and to claim that the moral consequences of socialism did in reality follow from the practical program. This is the course that was adopted by the Soviet regime, and it is difficult to see how it could have done otherwise without admitting that it had failed and that the system was a fraud.

zh: 另一种解决办法是说，苏联革命的中心目标是实现非资本主义的工具性纲领——即终结私有财产——而既然这一点已经实现，苏维埃秩序就是一种真实的、尽管不完整的社会主义。这是托洛茨基、布哈林以及后来众多评论者——无论在俄国还是国外，从罗伊·麦德维杰夫和戈尔巴乔夫到无数西方权威——所采取的道路。这种解决办法当然包含前面提到的畸变论、历史的‘坏人’论，以及/或者俄国专制、官僚制和落后的沉重遗产。在1991年之前，它还意味着相信，随着时机成熟，社会主义的道德纲领会被添加到工具性纲领之上。正是这种充满希望、令人宽慰的中间道路（
），在东方和西方都远远是解决苏维埃难题最流行的方案。
en: Another solution is to say that the central objective of the Soviet Revolution was realization of the instrumental program of non-capitalism—namely, the end of private property—and that since this had been achieved, the Soviet order was a real, if incomplete, socialism. This is the course taken by Trotsky, Bukharin, and a multitude of later commentators, both in Russia and abroad, from Roy Medvedev and Gorbachev to any number of Western authorities. This solution, of course, embraces the already mentioned aberration thesis; the badman theory of history; and/or the heavy heritage of Russian autocracy, bureaucracy, and backwardness. And until 1991 it entailed the belief that in the fullness of time the moral program of socialism would be added to the instrumental one. It is this hopeful and consoling
that has been far and away the most popular solution to the Soviet conundrum, both in the East and in the West.

zh: 但还有第三种解决办法，即认为社会主义的工具性纲领会十分合乎逻辑地导致其道德纲领的败坏。换句话说，完整社会主义的失败并非源于它最初在错误的地方——俄国——试行，而是源于社会主义观念本身。失败的原因在于，作为完全非资本主义的社会主义本质上是不可能的。因为压制私有财产、利润和市场，等于压制市民社会和一切个体自主。虽然这一点可以在短时间内近似实现，但它需要过度使用武力，而这种武力无法无限期维持。
en: But there is a third solution, which is to say that the instrumental program of socialism leads quite logically to the perversion of its moral program. In other words, the failure of integral socialism stems not from its having been tried out first in the wrong place, Russia, but from the socialist idea per se. And the reason for this failure is that socialism as full noncapitalism is intrinsically impossible. For the suppression of private property, profit, and the market is tantamount to the suppression of civil society and all individual autonomy. And although this can be approximated for a time, it requires an inordinate application of force that cannot be sustained indefinitely.

zh: 因此，从实际效果看，社会主义导致的不是对“资本主义”具体弊端的攻击，而是对整个现实本身的攻击。它实际上变成了一种压制现实世界的努力，而这种努力从长远看不可能成功。但在很长一段时期内，这种努力确实能够成功地创造一个超现实的世界：在这个世界里，低效、贫困和残暴可以被官方说成社会的至善（summum bonum）；在这个世界里，社会无法挑战这场骗局。
en: As a practical matter, therefore, socialism leads not to an assault on the specific abuses of “capitalism” but to an assault on reality
. It becomes, in effect, an effort to suppress the real world, and this is something that cannot succeed in the long run. But for a protracted period this effort

succeed in creating a surreal world, one defined by the paradox that inefficiency, poverty, and brutality can be officially presented as the summum bonum of society, and one where society is unable to challenge this fraud.

zh: 斯大林死后，东欧异见者第一次能够发声时，采取的正是这种对苏维埃难题的解决办法。而1989—1991年，东欧大多数人民正是依据这一解决办法行动：他们断定这个制度无法改革，必须废除；私有财产、利润和市场这些基本社会现实必须恢复，东方才有可能走出“现实存在的”社会主义那失败的超现实世界。
en: It is this resolution of the Soviet conundrum that East European dissidents adopted when they were first able to speak up after Stalin’s death. And it is on this solution that the majority of the people of Eastern Europe acted in 1989-1991 when they concluded that the system could not be reformed but had to be abolished, and that the basic social realities of private property, profit, and the market had to be restored if ever the East was to make an exit from the failed surreality of “really-existing” socialism.

zh: 但所有这些要变得清晰，还需要半个世纪。与此同时，该政权最大的成功还在前头。1934—1935年，斯大林给他的国家一段新的喘息时光，一个小型新经济政策——但只发生在心理层面。随着第二个、更为清醒的五年计划展开，配给制现在可以结束了。于是领袖用一句新口号宣布：“生活变得更好了，生活变得更快乐了。”但这只是他着手通过大清洗完成其事业之前的短暂喘息。
en: But it would take a half-century for all of this to become clear. In the meantime the regime’s greatest successes were still before it. In 1934-1935 Stalin gave his country a new breathing spell, a mini-NEP—but only in the psychological sphere. With a second and more sober Five-Year Plan under way, rationing could now come to an end. The Leader therefore proclaimed in a new slogan that “life has become better, life has become more joyous.” But this was only a respite before he moved to complete his work through the Great Purges.
